title: Top Pet Cameras to Check on Your Pets (2026)
summary: The top pet cameras for 2026 combine 360‑degree view, treat dispensing, and smart alerts, with the Furbo 360 Dog and Furbo Mini 360° leading the pack.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the provided sources (PCMag, Consumer Reports, Reviewed, Wired). Ranked by how many sources mention them and by the prominence given in those sources.
assumptions: Prices are taken only when explicitly stated; if a source lists a price, it is used; otherwise price is null.

products.name: Furbo 360 Dog Camera
why: The PCMag review calls it one of their two favorites, praising its sharp view, treat dispensing, and alerts. The Consumer Reports review lists it with a $249 price and notes its live video, treat‑tossing, and two‑way communication. Both sources highlight its 360‑degree view and color night vision.
products.best_for: Dog owners who want a full‑spectrum view and treat interaction
products.skip_if: You need local storage or Google Assistant integration

products.name: Petcube Bites 2
why: Reviewed calls it a treat‑tossing pet camera with 1080p video and a 160‑degree field of view. Wired also mentions it as a compact 360 rotating budget pick, highlighting its Alexa integration and large size.
products.best_for: Owners who want treat dispensing and Alexa integration
products.skip_if: You need a compact form factor

products.name: Petcube Cam 360
why: Reviewed describes it as an affordable compact camera with great features and a narrow viewing angle. Wired lists it as a compact 360 rotating budget pick, noting its affordability at $47.
products.best_for: Owners looking for a cheap, wireless 360° camera
products.skip_if: You need advanced features or treat dispensing
